title: Apply a function on a column based on condition of another column
question:
Want to apply a logic on a column based on a condition on another column, pandas version of code is

df['cid_cm11_new'] = df.apply(lambda row: 
str(row['id']).split('.')[0].rjust(15,'0') if row['code'] == "O" else str(row['id2']).split('.')[0].rjust(9,'0'), axis=1)

want to convert this to Pyspark logic, since my dataframe length is huge.
answer:
Use this code:

    df1 = df.withColumn(
    "cid_cm11_new",
    F.when(
        F.col("code") == "O",
        F.lpad(F.split(F.col("id"), "\.")[0], 15, "0")
    ).otherwise(
        F.lpad(F.split(F.col("id2"), "\.")[0], 9, "0")
    )
)

    display(df1)
